bio.text: Jim Dotson was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2022 and sworn in on January 9, 2023; he represents District 34 in Benton County.
He served in the Arkansas House from 2013 through 2022 and earlier served two terms on the Bentonville City Council.
He lives in Bentonville and is in the roofing business, a realtor, and builds houses in Northwest Arkansas.

sources.title: Biography of THE HONORABLE JIM DOTSON
